legacyHotspots.rationale: The composition root wires runtime owners, window presentation, coordinators, worker adapters, and IPC; this strict cap prevents product workflows from returning. Fork: +5 over upstream's zero-headroom cap for the single BeadsService and GasCityService owner calls (construction extracted to beads-owner.ts / gascity-owner.ts); the getProject closure is shared with the IPC router.

The renderer root is now a composition shell for feature-owned models and views; this strict cap prevents it from reabsorbing feature state and policy. Fork: +6 over upstream's cap for the beads rail composition wiring (BeadsRail import, useBeadsWorkspace hook, BeadsRailTab, BeadsRailPanel, and the attachRequest prop); all beads state and policy live in beads/BeadsRail.
The public SshHost owns one authentication, connection, cache, and capacity policy while delegating file, watch, and transport-pool mechanics to private collaborators.

TerminalWorkspace is now the feature composition view over extracted policy, effects, persistence, recovery, and presentation modules; the named cap preserves that boundary. Fork: +22 over upstream's zero-headroom cap for the crew-attach wiring (attachRequest prop, initialInput threading, focus-or-attach ports); the effect, the launched-terminal map, and the resolution rule live in use-terminal-attach-request.ts and the model.

TerminalRuntime owns one session's PTY start, resume, and fresh-replacement lifecycle over the recovery-refactored event router. Fork: +15 over upstream's cap for the crew initial-input auto-run (typed once on first launch, suppressed on reconnect, manual restart, and fresh replacement), driven by the beads panel through the initialInput option.
HarnessProfilesSettings composes extracted profile policy, controller, fields, and dialogs; the named cap prevents those responsibilities from moving back into the view.
GitEngine is the stable facade over capability modules and the shared command context; its lower named cap prevents the facade from reabsorbing capability implementations.
The root stylesheet is an explicit ordered import manifest; its lower named cap prevents feature rules from returning to the global composition surface.
Legacy end-to-end SshHost adapter characterization remains in one test module while new collaborator policy is tested in focused modules.
The remaining transitional renderer workflow stays production-composed while focused PTY, viewer-position, and packaged platform contracts run independently.
